STRUCTURAL SPECIFICATION - RESIDENTIAL BLOCK A
Section 3: Concrete
All RCC work shall use concrete grade M25 conforming to IS 456.
Reinforcement steel shall be Fe500D TMT bars.
Section 4: Masonry
External walls shall be 200 mm thick solid concrete block.
Internal partition walls: 100 mm thick.
Section 5: Slabs
Slab thickness: 150 mm for all floors.
Section 6: Doors
Main door width 1000 mm, door height 2100 mm.
Typical floor height 3000 mm.
